node.title: Remove ÿþ from a string
node.author: AnishaM
node.doctext:
Hi PerlMonks,
Is there a way to remove BOM ÿþ from a string? Last time I saw such characters while reading my file for which I got help from you all who pointed at encoding problem. But is there a way to remove ÿþ from a string? I tried this: s/^\N{ZERO WIDTH NO-BREAK SPACE}//; and s/[\xFE\xFF]/\x{FFFD}/g But I am not able to resolve this issue? Could you please give me some hints on how do I solve this issue? I have been stuck with this issue from 2 days. Thanks in advance.
Regards, AnishaM
